name: image_adjudication_cx_vs_pod_agent
functionality: Conditional agent (runs only when POD images exist, ~35% of incidents). Compares Customer Images against POD (Proof of Delivery - last mile) Images to verify identity match between what was delivered at doorstep and what customer is showing during return. Similar cross-referencing logic to cx_vs_obd_agent but for POD-specific images.
inputs: cx_images (customer images), pod_images (POD/last-mile images), product_title, return_reason, return_sub_reason, vertical
promptDescription: Conditional prompt - triggered only when POD images are available (runs for ~35% of incidents). Cross-references customer images with POD (Proof of Delivery) last-mile images. Similar framework to cx_vs_obd_agent with identity verification and damage assessment between the two image sets.
promptVersions: Conditional prompt (version details in cx_vs_obd framework)
